verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning platform that stores customer PII, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints or data-purge controls. The mentions that Alloy stores event data and keeps entities in a shared data store describe storage, not user control over retention or deletion. Entity merging is an adjacent feature, not deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
